Definition: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangor of trumpets, as an alarum
BiblicalUsage: 1) alarm, signal, sound of tempest, shout, shout or blast of war or alarm or joy; 1a) alarm of war, war-cry, battle-cry; 1b) blast (for march); 1c) shout of joy (with religious impulse); 1d) shout of joy (in general)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
